BiblicalUsage: Beth-Ezel means house of narrowing, and Micah names it once, in Micah 1:11, in a lament over the towns of Judah: the inhabitant of Zaanan came not forth in the mourning of Beth-ezel. A place too hemmed in, too afraid, to come out and help — its name became its story.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Micah's picture still stings: fear can narrow a whole town until it will not move.
